subject.title: fix(onboard): validate reset options before deleting state

question: Should `openclaw onboard --reset` reject migration-import flows until migration providers expose a reusable side-effect-free import plan, or should reset-plus-import remain supported through a different validated path?
rationale: This is an intentional behavior and compatibility choice for existing onboarding automation, not a mechanical test or type correction that review automation can safely decide.

options.title: Accept temporary fail-closed behavior
options.body: Merge with a documented rejection for reset-plus-import until providers can supply a read-only import plan.

options.title: Preserve reset-plus-import now
options.body: Require a safe preflight/import-plan design before merging so existing reset-plus-import automation remains supported.

recommendation.title: Accept temporary fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Merge with a documented rejection for reset-plus-import until providers can supply a read-only import plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author supplied the current reset and migration-preflight design rationale and is the best available routing candidate in the supplied context.
